prompt: Documentary still life photograph in a bright, quiet print room, cool daylight, shallow depth of field, calm and precise editorial look, but vivid: saturated process inks (cyan, magenta, yellow) and coloured paper stocks against paper white and slate blue. A wooden board with small brass pins and taut fine threads stretched between them, threads crossing from one cluster of pins to another like a string map of connections; the threads are cyan, magenta and yellow, one vermilion. Absolutely no legible text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no trademarks.
